name: insales_app_node
description: План заготовки устанавливаемого партнёрского приложения InSales на Node.js и TypeScript.

scripts.build: tsc && cp -r templates dist/templates && cp -r public dist/public && cp -r migrations dist/migrations
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:migrate: tsx -e "import { loadConfig } from './src/config.js'; import { buildApp } from './src/app.js'; const app = await buildApp(loadConfig()); await app.fastify.close();"
scripts.db:status: tsx -e "import { loadConfig } from './src/config.js'; import { initDb } from './src/storage/database.js'; import { migrationStatus } from './src/storage/migrate.js'; const c = loadConfig(); const db = initDb(c); console.table(migrationStatus(db));"
